title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode8 Though I Want to Disappear

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Though I Want to Disappear

rows.Line: Miku, why are there people here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Yuki? Now that you mention it, it does sound like her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But is this really Yuki?
She seems completely different from when we talk on Nightcord.
And you two must be Enanan and Amia.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm so glad you're okay, Yuki!
We were getting worried after not hearing from you for so long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Have you been here the whole time?
Did you get stuck here because you couldn't find a way to get back?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's wrong? Yuki, are you okay?
Are you hungry from not having eaten since you got here or something?
Stay out of my world and leave me alone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What is that supposed to mean?
Are you saying you don't want to go home?
I want to be left alone here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um... Then, does that mean you don't want to keep making songs with us?
That's right. How many times do I have to say it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but this kinda feels a bit sudden, you know? Look, even Kanade is surprised. Right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does that mean you just want to make songs by yourself from now on as OWN?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Yuki is OWN? What are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have none, but I can tell.
The songs may be completely different than the ones we make as N25, but I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? So that means the entire time Amia and I were talking about OWN the other day...
I didn't see any reason to tell you, so I didn't.
I've never spoken to you as anyone other than Yuki, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So what was going through your head while I went off about how amazing you were without even knowing the truth? Were you just having a laugh at my expense?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
C-Calm down, Enanan!
Can we at least talk about this a little more, Yuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even if you are OWN, do you really have to stop being part of N25? This is all way too sudden...
There's no reason for me to remain part of N25.
K, the first time I heard your songs, I felt like they had saved me. A little bit.
So I thought being near you might be enough to help me find what I was looking for.
But it wasn't enough. I wasn't able to find anything.

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I felt like your song saved me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So...I wasn't able to save you...?
And if being around you won't help me find what I'm looking for, then I'll just have to do it on my own.
Miku, I have nothing else to say to these people. Get them out of here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can you really find what you're looking for on your own?
If you say there's still a possibility I can find myself, then I will give up everything to do so.

That is the only option left.
But if I can't find myself even then...then I'll just have to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What the heck are you even talking about?! Being saved?! Disappear?! What's wrong with you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, let's talk about this. You're acting strange, Yuki.
Strange? If I'm strange, then so are all of you.

Be honest, K, Enanan, Amia...
You all want to disappear more than anyone.
And yet you call me strange?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously, what's gotten into you, Yuki? What do you mean I want to disappear? I love my life, so why would I think that?
You don't have to do this anymore.
Amia, you always act like you're having fun, but deep down you know exactly what I'm talking about, don't you?
Miku. I don't want these people in my world.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? When Miku touched her, she just disappeared!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But please...find a way to save Mafuyu.
